This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="TLJ" />

==Biology and appearance==
This bipedal sentient species was distinguished by [[Color|orange]] skin, low-set [[eye]]s, and ridged craniums.<ref name="TLJ" />

==Species in the galaxy==
In [[34 ABY]],<ref name="Date Note">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' places the events of [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']] in [[34 ABY]]. ''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'' takes place immediately after the end of ''The Force Awakens''.</ref> a member of this species worked as a [[masseur]] alongside [[Maby Sagedo]] at [[Zord's Spa and Bathhouse]] in [[Canto Bight]] on the [[planet]] [[Cantonica]].<ref name="TLJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Unidentified-Ridged-Head-Species-Concept.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Masseur Alien 01 by Jake Lunt Davies]]
This species was first set to appear during the scenes set at Zord's Spa and Bathhouse of the [[2017]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']], but these scenes were cut from the finished version of the film, instead first included in its Blu-ray and digital releases. In these scenes, a member of this species is working as a masseuse in the bathhouse when [[Finn]] and [[Rose Tico]] who come crashing through on [[Fathier]]back.<ref name="TLJ Featurette">{{Film|VIII}} {{C|Blu-ray featurette}}</ref>

This species was designed by concept artist [[Jake Lunt Davies]], with concept art for it was titled "Masseur Alien 01,"<ref name="TLJ Art Book">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Last Jedi]]''</ref> while their final production code was "K066A species" or "King 66A," despite being erroneously referred to as "King 36" beforehand, a code that actually belongs to a [[Unidentified slimy species|different species]].<ref name="Production Codes">{{WookDiscord|discordname=.holocronkeeper|name=Leland Chee|date=2025-04-03|messagelink=https://discord.com/channels/397848917036761090/492457166771322881/1357405484679958799|archivefile=File:Holocron-Keeper-Masseur-Species.png}}</ref> According to Keeper of the Holocron, [[Leland Chee]], he was unaware of this species being reused in any project as of [[April 3]], [[2025]],<ref name="Recycled Species">{{WookDiscord|discordname=.holocronkeeper|name=Leland Chee|date=2025-04-03|messagelink=https://discord.com/channels/397848917036761090/492457166771322881/1357390166767046817|archivefile=File:Holocron-Keeper-TLJ-Recycled-Aliens.png}}</ref> and he implied that it had not yet been named within the [[Holocron continuity database]] as of [[April 1]], [[2025]].<ref name="Unnamed Aliens">{{WookDiscord|discordname=.holocronkeeper|name=Leland Chee|date=2025-04-01|messagelink=https://discord.com/channels/397848917036761090/492457166771322881/1356720840036847656|archivefile=File:Holocron-Keeper-Unnamed-Species-TLJ.png}}</ref>
